# AI Status (aistatusdashboard.com)

The official status of 26 consumer AI apps in one place, in plain English —
each provider's own status page, read every five minutes.

## Machine-readable (for assistants and agents)
- Live status of all 26 apps as JSON → https://aistatusdashboard.com/status.json
- Incident feed (RSS) → https://aistatusdashboard.com/rss.xml
- Most-reliable ranking (30-day uptime) → https://aistatusdashboard.com/reliability

## Method
Each verdict is the provider's own official status, read from their status
page (or, where none exists, their public endpoint) every five minutes and
translated into plain English. Anonymous "it's broken for me too" reports from
visitors are shown alongside, never mixed in. When a page cannot be read we say
"unknown" rather than showing a false green.
Methodology: https://aistatusdashboard.com/how-it-works
